mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_record (user_id, date, type, img, meal_time, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{type}, #{img}, #{mealTime}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT meal_record_id, user_id, date, type, img, meal_time, content FROM meal_r WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date} ORDER BY case WHEN type = '아침' THEN 1 WHEN type = '점심' THEN 2 WHEN type = '저녁' THEN 3 END, meal_record_id;
mapper.update: UPDATE meal_record SET type = #{type}, img = #{img}, meal_time = #{mealTime}, content = #{content} WHERE meal_record_id = #{mealRecordId}
